component.name: Periphera
component.summary: Control Barracuda X Chroma and Naga V2 Pro peripherals

description.p: An independent Linux controller with a charcoal and green interface for the Razer Barracuda X Chroma headset and Razer Naga V2 Pro mouse.

ul.li: Headset battery, equalizer, microphone monitoring and six-zone lighting
Mouse DPI, polling rate, battery, sleep timeout and lighting through OpenRazer
Read-only mouse preview for exploring the interface without hardware
Explicit Apply actions and device response diagnostics

description.p: Mouse integration is experimental and needs testing by device owners. Install OpenRazer on the host for mouse control. The headset needs a host udev permission rule. Bluetooth mouse configuration, button remapping, onboard profile management and HyperScroll tuning are not included.
This is not an official Razer application or a complete Synapse replacement.
Add experimental Naga V2 Pro controls and Flatpak packaging.
